items.html: AVI, called Hochma and Bina de Atzilut, take only the Bina of MA between them, which is the Behinat Tagin de MA. ZA de Atzilut and Nukva, which are the seven bottom Sefirot de Atzilut, take the Behinat Otiot of the name MA, which are also the seven bottom Sefirot of the name MA; ZAtakes six and Nukva takes the seventh.Thus, the division of the Eser Sefirot de MA in the Eser Sefirot de Atzilut has been thoroughly clarified. You find, that they are not aimed together.
